title: VEILED-SH: Vulnerability Expression through Indirect Language Evaluation Dataset (Self-Harm)
abstract: arXiv:2610.26190v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI systems may miss indirect, culturally situated distress or provide support mismatched to the application context. Existing benchmarks do not jointly address cultural variation, application context, and practitioner disagreement. We introduce VEILED-SH, a benchmark and construction methodology for evaluating single-turn responses to indirect expressions of suicide, self-harm, and distress. Its 10,003 prompts span counselor chat, forum posts, platform search, and triage, drawing on Singapore-grounded sources and public datasets. An expert-validated multi-label taxonomy distinguishes intent, communicative function, and response behavior. Six automated profiles, individually calibrated to three peer-support practitioners and three clinicians, retain separate reference policies for proxy-alignment scoring. translated_title: VEILED-SH：通过间接语言的脆弱性表达评估数据集（自伤）
translated_abstract: AI 系统可能会遗漏间接的、带有文化背景的痛苦表达，或提供与应用场景不匹配的支持。现有的基准测试未能同时解决文化差异、应用场景和从业者意见分歧这三个问题。我们提出了 VEILED-SH，一个用于评估 AI 对自杀、自伤和痛苦间接表达的单轮回复的基准测试及构建方法。该数据集包含 10,003 个提示词，涵盖咨询师聊天、论坛帖子、平台搜索和分诊四种场景，数据来源于新加坡本地资源和公开数据集。经专家验证的多标签分类体系可区分意图、交际功能和回应行为。六个自动化画像分别针对三位同伴支持从业者和三位临床医生进行校准，并为代理对齐评分保留了独立的参考策略。在覆盖度加权的样本上对五个系统进行评估，结果显示各画像生成的参考策略之间的代理对齐程度存在差异。
tldr: 该论文提出 VEILED-SH 基准数据集（含 10,003 个提示词），首次将文化背景、应用场景和从业者分歧三者结合，用于评估 AI 对自杀与自伤间接表达的单轮回复，并通过专家校准的自动化画像实现代理对齐评分。
en_tdlr: VEILED-SH introduces a 10,003-prompt benchmark for evaluating single-turn AI responses to indirect expressions of suicide, self-harm, and distress, uniquely combining cultural variation, application context, and practitioner disagreement through expert-calibrated automated profiles for proxy-alignment scoring.
